tasks.title: E33 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E33 (Stay or return). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E33.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E33/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E33/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

ticket_tasks.brief:

Read providers' application ports when delivered; never import another module's domain/adapters/api or copy its implementation. Use SYSTEM 10 kernel.testing fakes for component tests until providers exist; no fake is a production fallback or real-stack acceptance. All new test paths here are partitions of docs/tdd/E33.md section 13's test/feature/scenario directories. Record R/V/D/invariant and T33 IDs on every test. Missing dependencies and gates stay failures, never skips, xfails or weakened assertions. Shared mechanisms: SYSTEM 5.1 IDs, 5.2 UTC/injected clock, 5.3 mission labels, 5.4 Decimal/UCUM quantities, 5.5 typed ProblemError/ErrorEnvelope, 5.6 immutable release/pins, 5.7 read snapshots/UoW/events, 5.8 target-bound durable identity, 5.9 complete hash chain, 5.10 shared scheduler/health, 5.11 bounded settings, 5.12 composition, 6.2 uv, 6.4 imports and 6.5 guarded generated contracts. Do not implement local replacements. Q1/Q7/Q18 permit sourced eligible content with the configured not-clinically-reviewed status; they do not waive source/purpose/hash/origin, authorization or executable-step checks. Build only the pure projection and its readiness-owned application contracts, E33 sections 3.1 to 3.3, 3.5, 3.6 and 4.1. The finite file list is E33 section 13 (docs/tdd/E33.md:571). Types from section 3.1 are ReturnOption, Criterion, PrepareStepDef, PctRange, Rtdc, ReturnStage, RunStepState, RunStep, ReturnRun, ReturnRuns and ReadinessWords; implement compute_return_readiness and prepare projection exactly. Place pure shared parser result declarations named in section 3.4 (FormPage, Table4Refusal, Table4, RtdcVerdict and Verified/Mismatch/Refused/SourceUnreadable) in model.py so T2 can implement parsing without T1 importing domain/rtdc.py. These are local domain values, not handwritten wire schemas; response and common reference shapes are generated from common.schema.json and return-readiness.schema.json at boundaries. No domain import of Pydantic or provider types. Keep the exact four run-step states and wire's two prepare states. Percent ranges reject nonfinite, negative, reversed and above-100 values with typed errors. Map module-boundary percentages to SYSTEM 5.4 Quantity/Unit '%' without changing numeric wire properties; P3 must settle the shared mapper/export before dispatch of disputed public contracts.

Selection: null active option gives NotApplicable; candidates already filtered by subject and environment by their owner. latest_open wins; otherwise latest_closed only if any of its return prepare run steps is done (E33 3.2 rule 4). Open with projected done is preparing, otherwise open; selected closed preparing_return is preparing, otherwise stood_down; no selection is closed with empty lists and nullable fields null. No expiry, activation-time cutoff, timestamp sorting or bounded-history truncation. Words/stage come from the selected run's pins; trip and applicability from the active release. Every criterion stays unknown with evidence_ids empty, and criteria_text is the pinned pending word only while a criterion is to be set by flight rules. Null RTDC stays null. Projection preserves document order, excludes absent/principal unavailable states, and substitutes only when the principal is unavailable/substituted; emit a substitute only with its own open/done state and attribution, with no duplicate substitute or invented open step.

application/ports.py exposes the readiness consumer contracts from E33 4.1 and re-exports only its local read-only DTOs. Replace ReadUnit with SYSTEM 5.7 ReadSnapshot. Do not declare copies of E01 ConfigReader, E02 roster/session or E23 MissionStatePort. P2/P3 must ratify candidate visibility, exact DTO mappings and the no-plans-imports-readiness verifier ownership before those ports are published. RtdcVerificationPort.verify(rtdc) -> RtdcVerdict may be readiness's local contract, not authority for E28 to import it. No ReadinessQueries signature or readiness_run schema is provided; P1 blocks their invention.

Write first T33-04/05/15 property tests (I33-03/06/07/09/11/12/13, CONTRACTS 27), including four step states, absent steps, inactive substitutes, nullable by/at, zero/maximum/nonfinite ranges, no run, multiple runs, closed dispositions, environment re-entry, equal opened_at and backward correction with owner commit order, a return run behind 199 unrelated records, and deterministic bytes after irrelevant input reordering. Readiness takes only two candidates, never searches a truncated list. Use configuration-derived text/step builders with explicit profiles; do not type clinical copy. Add the T33-13 component content-edit proof using scratch valid ui-copy/stage text, retaining old pins and changing no safety mapping. T33-10 parser properties belong to T2; storage, API, timeouts and real selection SQL belong to T3/E28; browser and real-stack proof belong to T4/T5. AGENTS 6 applicable failures are missing/corrupt pins/configuration, partial step inputs, delayed/reordered facts, clock and mission boundaries, multiple clients' states and privacy-safe inputs; this task makes no durable command. Done: exact pure rules and agreed consumer exports, property/content-edit tests and listed component gates pass; T5 still owes assembled coverage/mutation/acceptance.

parse_table4(pages) -> Table4 | Table4Refusal and verify_rtdc(rtdc, pages) -> RtdcVerdict use the exact grammar at docs/tdd/E33.md:183: one TABLE 4 title, correct page, TABLE 4 KEY on that or next page, at most 400 body lines, exact 25-line header, four ordered TBC/TWC/UTBC/UTWC row boundaries, valid probability cell and exactly ten following cells. CLI behavior from E33 5: source_id prints page, four ranges and row cells as JSON; --scan lists parseable saved forms; --check <onboard-plans.json> checks every non-null RTDC and returns nonzero on any bad verdict. Build only the readiness feature, E33 sections 7, 9 and 10: ReturnCard.vue, WhoDecidesCard.vue, NoReturnCard.vue and useReturnReadiness.ts, plus their colocated unit/property/browser helper tests within the owned feature directory (docs/tdd/E33.md:396, :578). No Python package is owned here, so Python lint/types apply in T1/T2/T3; this task uses strict TypeScript, eslint/format, feature tests and the actual shared client scanner. Generated wire types/client come from @crew-health/contracts (SYSTEM 6.3/6.5). E03 owns ui/crew/src/shell/api/client.ts, api/events.ts, session.ts, copy.ts, stage.ts and StaleBanner.vue; E28 owns StepRow.vue, PlanView/PlanRun clients and mounting. P7 must deliver exact slot exports/binding for return and who_decides with {planView: PlanView, planRunId: string | null}. Never edit their files or guess a slot registration API. Component tests can use the documented props; actual mount/browser proof remains a prerequisite, not a fake wrapper claiming integration.

Planning content comes from displayed PlanView, including before a run: stage criteria, pending words, prepare step views, decided_by, who_decides_text, trip/source and nullable rtdc. No return stage means NoReturnCard from no_return_text, no WhoDecidesCard, no readiness call; Mars and transit show the configured words. Fetch getReturnReadiness only for a valid current return PlanView and authorized signed-in person; never station clinical overlay. Fetch getPlanRun only with a returned non-null ID and current grant. Apply overlay only after plan ID, environment, route run ID if present and the run's onboard-plans pin equal the displayed PlanView plan_version. A no-run, another-plan, two-run or older-pin result cannot add state/marks to mismatched content. Any link to a mismatched run requires current object access; knowing its ID is not access. Keep displayed content and its copy pin together, per SYSTEM 5.6/8.3 and E33 I33-11.

P7's X3 is a delivery prerequisite: return_words has rtdc_title, rtdc_note, treated, untreated, best_case, worst_case, range, rtdc_page, rtdc_none, stood_down and open_run, with authorized {min}/{max}/{page} templates. Current schema/example lacks that object, so do not add TS-only fields, hardcoded labels or omit the block as completion. Use E01 TemplateRenderer-compatible configured formatting: shortest exact decimal strings, no rounding/grouping, all four labeled treated/untreated best/worst ranges, source chip named by source title and page; null gives rtdc_none, never a number. RTDC is contextual NASA modeling, not this patient's probability or a decision score. Use semantic table headers, source links, ordered prepare list, aria-live polite state, no chance colors/icons/ranking.

Prepare controls are E28 StepRow and E03's durable client: preserve open/done/not_available/substituted, Not aboard, who_can and no Done when eligibility denies. SYSTEM 8.2 source/hash/purpose/pin/origin/equipment/stock/skills/operator checks remain mandatory in E28; UI never calculates its own eligibility or medicine/return criteria. Display configured not-clinically-reviewed status under Q1/Q7/Q18 without inventing a review gate. An unavailable/incapacitated officer or the officer as subject never gets their own officer prepare action. No readiness command or local step ledger is added.

Request token includes session, subject, plan, environment and counter; abort/invalidate on any context or access change, drop late responses, at most one request in flight plus one pending. ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, then every reads entry. The frozen design is docs/tdd/E33.md. PLAN.md Design deviations and Requests are binding dispatch conditions, not approved new interfaces. docs/requests/E33.md is currently absent: read the coordinator's promoted record when it exists; do not treat the design's request table as approval. Edit only owned_paths, including tests. Do not edit the design, contracts, configuration, authoring, shell, toolchains or another epic. Read providers' application ports when delivered; never import another module's domain/adapters/api or copy its implementation. Use SYSTEM 10 kernel.testing fakes for component tests until providers exist; no fake is a production fallback or real-stack acceptance. All new test paths here are partitions of docs/tdd/E33.md section 13's test/feature/scenario directories. Record R/V/D/invariant and T33 IDs on every test. Missing dependencies and gates stay failures, never skips, xfails or weakened assertions. Shared mechanisms: SYSTEM 5.1 IDs, 5.2 UTC/injected clock, 5.3 mission labels, 5.4 Decimal/UCUM quantities, 5.5 typed ProblemError/ErrorEnvelope, 5.6 immutable release/pins, 5.7 read snapshots/UoW/events, 5.8 target-bound durable identity, 5.9 complete hash chain, 5.10 shared scheduler/health, 5.11 bounded settings, 5.12 composition, 6.2 uv, 6.4 imports and 6.5 guarded generated contracts. Do not implement local replacements. Q1/Q7/Q18 permit sourced eligible content with the configured not-clinically-reviewed status; they do not waive source/purpose/hash/origin, authorization or executable-step checks. Own acceptance only, E33 sections 9 to 12 and 15. Put real HTTP/fault tests in hub/tests/readiness/e2e and scenario/browser tests and any explicit SIM test artifacts in eval/scenarios/stay_or_return (section 13). Do not repair a failing provider in this task; return the defect to its task/epic owner. P1 through P7 in PLAN.md are mandatory dispatch/readiness checks. E01/E02/E23/E28 and inherited E27 guidance must be the real implementations for positive acceptance; E10's manifest-pinned source/loader binding must exist for non-null RTDC, E03/E20/E21 for browser/offline/fixture/driver evidence. No new fixture runner, app factory, clock, fault mechanism or client scanner is invented. Exact shared entry is create_app(settings) -> FastAPI (SYSTEM 4.2). Use real temporary on-disk SQLite, composition discovery, identity/session middleware, configuration/release checks, mission/plans repositories, command ledger and event delivery. No in-hub mocks, dependency overrides, monkeypatched domain providers, direct SQL seeding or intercepted successful UI API responses. Optional model/devices/ground processes may be absent or use documented external fakes. Seed through E21's explicit demo profile and documented public APIs; use E01's approved platform.testing controls for clock/storage/process fault boundaries. Missing approved controls block the case.

Drive the real endpoints named in docs/product/api/openapi.yaml: getReturnReadiness GET /v1/return-readiness (:8391), getPlan GET /v1/plans/{plan_id} (:6511), startPlanRun POST /v1/plan-runs (:6662), getPlanRun GET /v1/plan-runs/{plan_run_id} (:6760), actOnPlanRun POST /v1/plan-runs/{plan_run_id}/actions (:6837), createConfigRelease POST /v1/config/releases (:708) and activateConfigRelease POST /v1/config/releases/{release_id}/activate (:881). The E21/SYSTEM actual launch and authentication bindings are prerequisites, not guessed functions. All commands use their generated requests, Idempotency-Key/If-Match rules and D8 ETags. Reuse actual generated IDs from responses. Pure example byte equality is T3's T33-02/03; real-stack tests compare the generated contract/expected clinical fields, not fixed illustrative seed IDs.

Write failing critical-path tests first, retaining each design trace. T33-01 and T33-17 (R60, UC26, V94, EI11) must both run with marker scenario_V94: before any run, display the eye lunar plan's criteria/four labeled RTDC ranges/trip/Who decides, then actual opening/preparation/closure and stood_down. Switch the same plan to both mars_surface and transit, require 422 with current_state and supported_alternative null, PlanView without a return stage and browser no_return_text/no readiness call. Owner API with valid station_leo return_option follows applicability, but station-session clinical access follows P2's accepted privacy resolution, not the obsolete T33-09 unrestricted 200. No evaluator ever changes unknown/evidence_ids=[], raises safety state, decides or waits on ground. Render all six existing demo act screens: no Return/Who decides/RTDC content and no readiness call (Mara plan_icl10). E33 owns no D assertion; do not reclassify a D test as covered.

T33-11 (I33-05/H2/CONTRACTS 11) uses createConfigRelease then actual activateConfigRelease: unchanged complete package/deployment examples pass; a changed RTDC value, wrong page, unreadable source, structurally refused source, invalid return-option/stage combination and removed sole criterion reject with findings at /plans/<i>/stages/<j>/rtdc or the exact differing field; activation is refused and active release/response stay unchanged. Resolve source through package plus document-local registry; RS32 need not be listed locally. Null RTDC remains valid, yields no invented number and bypasses only the numerical verifier. E28 owns mandatory 14f wiring and authoring, never substitute a CLI-only check. Assert independent ICL48 page-5 golden ranges 0..0/96..100/0..100/100..100, derived from the saved form/source check, not the proposed stage. Independent PDF check and checked_by/X18 record remain E28 provenance evidence, with no clinical-validation claim.

T33-13/14 (I33-04/11/13, charter configuration critical path) activate valid scratch edits to ui-copy and trip_text without environment switch, new-run criterion text/to_be_set_by and null RTDC. Selected older runs keep their plan/ui-copy pins while active trip/applicability updates. Atomic null return_option plus removal of its stage yields 422; sole criterion removal alone rejects. Race activation between logical query reads using real concurrent HTTP and approved controls: all fields/headers/as_of belong to one ReadSnapshot, never a mixed release/environment. No safety mapping edit. T33-04/05/06/15 acceptance also covers deterministic state, absent/substituted/not_available steps, environment re-entry, equal timestamps/backward corrections, latest closed dispositions and a relevant return run older than 199 unrelated runs. E28 orders committed candidates and bounds the query, not the test's timestamps or a local list.

T33-19 (charter durability, AGENTS 6) drives real actOnPlanRun step_done through the composition root: kill before/after each relevant command commit/acknowledgment, lose a committed response, retry same immutable key, restart then submit new-key no-op, retry beyond 24 hours validating D6 accepted receipt, reuse the key/body on another run and require conflict/null current_state, fail disk-full commit and observe step/readiness unchanged, and complete concurrently from two clients with stale If-Match merge. Accepted step/audit/outbox/ledger state survives once; unaccepted failures remain visibly pending. E01/E28 supply recovery/hash chain/idempotency. Exercise privacy revocation before replay too.

T33-07/08/09/12/16/20 (I33-08/10, H8 and charter privacy) prove model stopped, devices/camera absent and link up/delayed/down do not alter the same-time response or trigger a ground/model read. Owner succeeds; another crew/unknown subject, unshared officer, station, ground and operator cannot infer clinical state. Explicit full field/object grants permit exactly their view; partial/missing/expired/revoked consent denies rather than fabricates a response. Test authorized events and caches, revocation during in-flight responses, logout/crew switch and incapacitated subjects: fixed help remains, no emergency chart bypass. Corrupt/missing pinned configuration yields nonretryable INTERNAL_ERROR; storage lock/full and stalled provider beyond the approved P4 deadline yield retryable INTERNAL_ERROR, no partial body, no swallowed I/O/integrity error or stale-current result. Clock jumps and mission boundaries never resurrect old clinical facts.

Playwright is driven from the owned Python scenarios through E21's actual UI-driver binding against the running hub, not Vitest mounting alone. T33-16/17 and V98 assert no-run/another-plan/two-runs/old-pin mismatch, four step states and no Done for Not aboard/empty who_can, CMO away/as patient, source/page/table accessibility, exact non-rounded percentages, nullable RTDC/explicit stood_down, context switches and late/reordered responses, two-client events, SSE loss/reconnect/410, session clear and public-only hub-down cache. E28's printed release-backed card is the independent backup when the browser/hub is unavailable; remove the primary to prove it, keeping any clinical state unavailable. Run E21 source/built scan and verify a scratch valid copy edit changes the browser without a client-code change (V98); don't claim V98 solely from a source grep.

T33-18 measures p95 below 50 ms on the reference machine using 200 historical runs; record rig/release/clock and separate this observation from hermetic tests. Existing design test IDs T33-01 through T33-20 must all appear in the final trace, with R60/V94/V98 and applicable invariants; no coverage-driven filler tests. E01's shared Schemathesis/corpus/trace/safety/mutation checks must include the effective getReturnReadiness route and compute.py/rtdc.py, require 95% branch coverage on each readiness domain/application module, full safety-condition coverage, complexity <=15 and no surviving non-equivalent critical mutant. P6 must extend the owner tooling: its existing E01-only coverage inventory cannot consume this report as E33 proof. The coverage --cov-fail-under aggregate command is necessary but insufficient without that per-module checker. Do not edit toolchain/manifest files here or let an empty target pass.

Done only after all listed real-stack and scenario gates pass, P1-P7 are closed with evidence, all T33 traces are present, performance is honestly recorded, independent build review is resolved and CI is green.
